Município de Marliédra: Parque Estadual do Rio Doce. "Campolina" section. Virgin evergreen broadleaf forest with trees 30-35 m tall, trunks upto 1-2 m diam. (some with buttress roots), forming open upper layer (Lecythis pisonis, L. Ollaria, Cariniana estrellensis, C. brasiliensis, Paratecoma peroba, Cecropia with stilt roots, etc.). Lower trees, including the palms Euterpe edulis & Astrocaryum arari, filling in canopy. Some thick lianas, many saplings & shrubs (Psychotria, etc.), 2-3 1/2 m tall Helioconia, some thin bamboo, many herbaceous & thin woody vines (some thorny); large number of terrestrial & low height epiphytic ferns. Soil light beige clay, hard when dry.
